title: Distr Launch Week: Our docs are now built with Starlight instead of Docusaurus
summary: Comparing Docusaurus vs Distr incl. Design, SEO, DevEx, Extensibility and how we structured our technical documentation
body_text: I am Philip, an engineer working at Glasskube. We are building an Open Source control plane for self-hosted, BYOC, and on-prem deployments. Everything you need to distribute applications to self-hosted customers out of the box is called Distr ( github.com/distr-sh/distr ). We previously built all our technical documentation, including this website, with Docusaurus. We generally liked using a static page generator and having all content fully Open Source on GitHub, so everyone can create a pull request if they find a typo or want to improve our docs. But for Distr, we decided to switch to Starlight. In this blog post, we will compare Docusaurus and Starlight and explain why we made the switch. Additionally, we will share how we structured our technical documentation and what we learned along the way. This post is actually the last piece of the Distr launch week. Up until now, we launched: On Monday: Tutorials for easy onboarding On Tuesday: Docker Swarm Support On Wednesday: Dashboard Unification with metrics On Thursday: OCI Artifact Registry is GA Read all about the Distr launch week here: #distr-launch-week . Coming back to the original topic: You can check out the source code of this exact website at github.com/glasskube/glasskube.dev , and you will see, it is built with Docusaurus. Although Docusaurus did its job quite well, we decided to use Starlight which is built on top of Astro for our Distr docs. After working with both frameworks, I am able to summarize the differences and point out the biggest distinctions. There are many popular open source frameworks for building great documentation and even more static site renderers (SSR), which can be customized to serve documentation. To some extent, choosing Starlight was a gut decision, and we are only able to compare Astro to Docusaurus. Another alternative worth mentioning is MkDocs ( mkdocs.org ). Material for MkDocs in particular looks really stunning. Docusaurus vs. Starlight - What to look at? When evaluating a static site renderer for our documentation, I’m looking for something that fulfills the following criteria: Design : A nice documentation framework looks sleek and modern by default but can still be easily customized to look unique. SEO : All required SEO features (description, sitemaps, page structures) should be available and built into the framework. DevEx : Developer experience should be great. Build times and reloads should be fast, and there shouldn’t be an endless number of third-party dependencies to get started. Extensibility: It should be possible to also create marketing pages with the same framework. Another factor to look at is obviously maturity and age. Although Docusaurus was first released in 2017 by Joel Marcey, see his blog post about Introducing Docusaurus , it is still actively maintained. Starlight v0.0.1 was first released in 2023, so 5 years later. Docusaurus vs. Starlight: Design Docusaurus and Starlight have made quite different decisions regarding design. Docusaurus uses Infima ( infima.dev ) at its core. It is actually pretty tightly coupled, so if you want to style specific pages or use CSS classes to style some components, you need to get familiar with Infima. Sadly, Infima isn’t very mature yet and it doesn’t provide primitives for a lot of components and possibilities that a framework like Bootstrap offers. Also, integrating Bootstrap or Tailwind is not really possible. Starlight and Astro, on the other hand, don’t come with a specific CSS framework built in, but provide a one-line command with their CLI to integrate Tailwind. Read more about Starlight and Tailwind . It took a while until Starlight fully supported Tailwind v4. But once #2862 was completed, upgrading Starlight from Tailwind v3 to v4 worked very well and was pretty well documented. Docusaurus vs. Starlight: SEO Both frameworks provide all the necessary features to configure HTML tags like <description> out of the box. You can read the SEO guide for Docusaurus or check out all the SEO Integrations for Astro which come preconfigured with Starlight. As both frameworks support static rendering at build time, page loading is lightning fast and is only slowed down by external libraries that are integrated. Feature Docusaurus Starlight Sitemap generation ✅ ✅ Metadata & Open Graph ✅ ✅ Broken Link Checker ✅ ✅ Image Optimization & compression ⚠️ (hard to get it working) ✅ It should be noted that all features for Starlight are only available via plugins and not part of the core Astro framework. I strongly recommend to always run your website through Google’s PageSpeed Insights Test Docusaurus vs. Starlight: Developer experience Both Docusaurus and Starlight are built on top of existing web frameworks. While Docusaurus is built upon React, Starlight is based upon Astro. Astro itself can be used with multiple different frameworks, including React, Vue, and Svelte. A framework for writing documentation should not hold you back from writing documentation quickly: It should not be a lot of effort to keep up to date. It should be fast, blazing fast. It should have useful integrations, documentation, and an active community. Maintenance work Docusaurus’ hard dependency on React introduces a natural update hurdle. Although React, Docusaurus, and Infima are all Open Source projects from Meta (formerly Facebook), they are developed by different teams. Not only does the Docusaurus team and you need to test compatibility with the latest React version, but also all plugins need to ensure compatibility. Only after the core team and all plugins support the latest version of React can you safely upgrade your Docusaurus version. Starlight, on the other hand, only depends on Astro, which is the same team building Starlight. This doesn’t seem to require the same amount of effort to keep up to date. It also has fewer moving parts. Speed To be completely honest: The reason I looked for another documentation framework was that I was fed up with Docusaurus taking forever to start the initial development server. With the latest Node version (24), Docusaurus version (3.7), and React version (19), it took a little over 5 seconds to start the development server. Although this number doesn’t seem to be that high, it was a lot higher with previous versions. I remember waiting over 20 seconds for the development server to start, which really frustrated me. Starlight, on the other hand, starts the development server in less than half the time Docusaurus takes. The biggest difference is that the Astro compiler github.com/withastro/compiler is written in Go instead of using JavaScript to build the website bundle. Integrations The only integration that is still missing and not available for Starlight is a Mermaid integration. Although Mermaid support ( #1259 ) is the second most requested feature after multiple sidebars ( #959 ), there is no official statement if it is on the roadmap. Also, no community plugin has yet been created. Currently, there is only a workaround with rendering Mermaid charts with Playwright. Find all Starlight plugins in the Starlight plugin directory and all Docusaurus integrations in the Docusaurus plugin directory . Feeling Starlight and Astro also felt more fun to use. Their CLI has nice animations, everything just looks a little bit more modern with all the fancy animations in the terminal. Docusaurus vs. Starlight: Extensibility—Adding Marketing pages When I tried to create marketing pages with Starlight in addition to the technical documentation, I nearly gave up. Coming from the Docusaurus world, this wasn’t an issue as the starter template comes with a front page and a blog out of the box. You can even create multiple documentations on different paths. We used /docs , for example. Starlight, on the other hand, is only built for documentation and not for marketing pages. It even took an ugly hack to make sure the default path is /docs and not / . Please don’t look at this custom script configured in our astro.config.mjs we need to execute on every page to make sure that the redirection works properly: { "tag" : " script " , "content" : " `window.addEventListener('load', () => document.querySelector('.site-title').href += 'docs/') " } We haven’t created any other marketing pages yet, but I am afraid that they will look quite a bit different from the Starlight documentation. Writing a technical documentation—What is important? When writing technical documentation, there are a few things to keep in mind. We will go over how we structured the content and what effects we observed on the viewed pages. Technical documentation structure Distr isn’t built for just one type of scenario. So rather than simply documenting features, we took inspiration from other project docs we really like, such as Flux and Docker and similarly structured our content. To first introduce core conceptual aspects relating to self-hosted deployments and Distr more generally, and from there, we connect those foundational concepts directly to practical use cases. New users typically start their journey in our Getting Started section. Here, we address questions such as “What exactly is Distr?”, “Who is it built for?” and “What can Distr do?” Afterward, users are prompted to move on to the Use Cases section. Ideally, this is the stage where users identify scenarios similar to their own deployment challenges. Only then do we guide the user to the detailed technical insights and precise implementation instructions found in the Guides and Product sections. Additionally, we offer complementary documentation for self-hosting Distr itself. Oh, and in case you were wondering: Yes, you can actually use Distr to self-host Distr! We also provide detailed resources on integrations, including how to leverage our API and SDK, as well as guides covering automation and authentication topics. Focusing on the most viewed pages Planning how your documentation should ideally be consumed is one thing, but understanding how it actually plays out in reality is another. By leveraging PostHog to monitor our documentation’s usage metrics, we’ve observed something probably obvious. People read the documentation often like a book, starting from the beginning and working their way through. So if there is any information you want them to read, make sure to put it at the beginning of the documentation. Writing style for technical documentation Let’s be honest, most people don’t spend their weekends curled up with documentation and a cup of warm cocoa. Good documentation doesn’t need poetic or elaborate prose. It just has to be clear, concise, and intuitively skimmable. When we write docs, we really try to remove unnecessary fluff and filler words and not be overly verbose. Every sentence should be in service to the user’s ability to quickly understand what your product does and, most importantly, how it solves the user’s specific problems. Fighting to retain attention is tough for any medium, but documentation writers have it the hardest since this is the prevailing sentiment they are up against. Making an effort to be clear, concise, and highly reliable has its payoffs though, since it doesn’t just help the human readers, but it also ensures that docs are structured in such a way that AI models can reliably interpret and communicate accurate information on your behalf. It’s also true that visuals can often communicate more clearly than words alone. That’s why we pair concise explanations with detailed, annotated screenshots and diagrams where needed. Conclusion Switching to a new technology always comes with a learning curve, but this time the learning curve wasn’t that steep. We are more than happy with the decision to switch to Starlight and Astro. The developer experience is much better, and the documentation looks way more modern out of the box. Although it was hard to accept that it is harder to build your marketing website and blog also with Starlight, and Mermaid integration is still missing, we are happy with the decision to use Starlight for our technical documentation and will also use it in our next projects. We would like to get your opinion. Which of the two documentation frameworks do you prefer? glasskube.dev built with Docusaurus distr.sh built with Starlight P.S.: Read all our announcements of this week’s launch week here: #distr-launch-week

title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces Date for First Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Conference Call
summary: Bit Digital (NASDAQ:BTBT) announced today that it will release its First Quarter 2025 results on Thursday, May 15, 2025, after the stock market closes. Senior management will host a live webcast and conference call to review results on Friday, May 16, 2025, at 10:00 a.m. ET.

title: Apollo MCP Server Launch Positions GraphQL as the Essential Protocol for AI-API Orchestration
summary: Best practices, tech talks, and customer stories to help you build, scale, and drive adoption of your graph.
body_text: New product establishes the graph-based industry standard for secure, orchestrated access to APIs in the age of AI SAN FRANCISCO, May 15, 2025 – Apollo GraphQL , the graph-based API orchestration leader, today announced the Apollo MCP Server, a solution that connects graph APIs to AI models using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). MCP has quickly emerged as the go-to standard for giving AI models access to data and capabilities beyond their training. With this new addition to Apollo's toolkit, developers can now harness GraphQL's power when building AI applications that need seamless AI access to data and services. The launch comes at a critical moment when organizations are racing to provide AI applications with appropriate access to their APIs. GraphQL, the emerging standard for declarative API orchestration, offers AI application builders a seamless path to quickly and safely build API-powered agentic software. Getting data from APIs into the right shape for AI consumption involves complex challenges around discovering, sequencing, security gating, retrying, parallelizing, caching, and numerous other functional and non-functional requirements. GraphQL's declarative, schema-driven approach to API orchestration provides these capabilities out-of-the-box, making it uniquely suited to serve as the foundation for MCP implementations, especially in an AI landscape where speed, security, and agility are paramount. “With the Apollo MCP Server, we’re establishing GraphQL as the essential protocol for AI-API orchestration,” said Matt DeBergalis, CTO and co-founder of Apollo GraphQL. "While MCP is still evolving, and perspectives on implementation will continue to mature as the technology develops, what's clear today is that GraphQL uniquely addresses the needs of AI by allowing teams to focus on building new AI-powered business capabilities, not rehashing endpoints specifically for AI integration. Safe, secure and performant AI needs graph-based API orchestration." The Apollo MCP Server provides capabilities that reinforce graph-based API orchestration as the essential approach for AI: Zero-code MCP tool creation: Apollo MCP Server lets developers instantly turn GraphQL schema or operations into MCP tools without writing a single line of procedural code. Native REST and GraphQL support: Apollo MCP works with any combination of unmodified REST APIs via Apollo Connectors as well as native GraphQL services. Deterministic, efficient execution: Apollo implements precise and consistent API call execution across every interaction. Built-in policy enforcement: AI interactions are limited to pre-approved operations and surface area, including complex orchestration workflows across multiple APIs. AI-native development: graph-based tools that allow AI-assisted and AI-automated workflows for automatically discovering and creating new capabilities across a complete API footprint. By implementing MCP, the Apollo MCP Server enables teams to move at AI speed while maintaining appropriate governance. It also simplifies deployment, with options to start in a local environment via Apollo's Rover CLI or deploy as a containerized service for seamless integration with your cloud infrastructure. The Apollo MCP Server is available today either by downloading and building from source code or deploying via ready-to-use containers. To learn more, visit the resources below: Learn how to get started with Apollo MCP Server for any GraphQL API. Read Apollo CTO Matt DeBergalis’s thoughts on how the future of MCP is GraphQL. Get hands-on with us on May 21 at 10:00 a.m.-10:45 a.m. PT and see it in action. Fast-track your learning with an Apollo Odyssey tutorial. Join the Apollo GraphQL Community . About Apollo GraphQL Apollo GraphQL helps developers build better software faster with a declarative, graph-based approach to API orchestration. With over 1 billion downloads of its open-source software, Apollo has become the standard for working with GraphQL and powers the most innovative brands today. The Apollo GraphOS® platform provides the infrastructure to unify APIs into a composable graph, enabling teams to query data from anywhere and ship new experiences with speed and confidence. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Insight Partners, Matrix Partners, and Trinity Ventures, Apollo is headquartered in San Francisco. Learn more at: https://www.apollographql.com .

title: Celebrating 45 Years of Excellence at American Woodmark
summary: This month marks a monumental milestone for American Woodmark as we celebrate 45 years of innovation, quality, and growth.
body_text: May 15, 2025 This month marks a monumental milestone for American Woodmark as we celebrate 45 years of innovation, quality, and growth. From our humble beginnings to becoming a leader in the cabinetry industry, we’ve come a long way—thanks to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the guidance of visionary leadership. As we reflect on this incredible journey, we are filled with pride for everything we’ve accomplished and excitement for the future ahead. A Proud Moment at NASDAQ To commemorate our 45th anniversary, American Woodmark’s leadership team had the honor of ringing the closing bell at NASDAQ in New York. This exciting event symbolized a major achievement for our company, showcasing the hard work and dedication that has brought us to this point. It was a moment of reflection on how far we’ve come and a celebration of all those who have contributed to American Woodmark’s success. This event was not only a proud moment for our team but also a reminder of the incredible journey ahead. As we continue to innovate and expand, the NASDAQ bell ringing was a tangible representation of how far we’ve come and the bright future that lies ahead. Thank You to the American Woodmark Family As we reflect on 45 years of growth, we want to take a moment to thank all of the employees, customers, and partners who have been part of our journey. From the first cabinet we built to the products we’re making today, it’s the people who make American Woodmark what it is. Your commitment, hard work, and loyalty have helped us reach this incredible milestone. To our employees, especially those who have been with us for many years, thank you for your dedication. To our customers, thank you for trusting us to deliver the best in cabinetry solutions. And to our partners, thank you for your continued collaboration and support. Looking Forward: The Next 45 Years While we celebrate our past achievements, we’re already looking forward to the next 45 years. American Woodmark will continue to push the boundaries of design, quality, and service. We remain committed to sustainability, innovation, and community involvement as we work towards an even brighter future. Here’s to the next chapter of American Woodmark— 45 years of excellence...and counting! Celebrating at our Corporate Headquarters in Winchester, VA

(NASDAQ: PRPO) , will be hosting its Q1-2025 corporate update call on May 15th, 2025 at 5:00 PM ET. The call will include updates on all of the company’s current core businesses. The conference call may be accessed by calling 844-695-5519 (international callers dial 1-412-902-6760). All callers should ask for the Precipio Inc. conference call. Participants may also pre-register for the conference call to https://dpregister.com/sreg/10199645/ff1acc6c66 and will receive a calendar invite and a direct dial-in number, bypassing the operator. Listeners interested in submitting questions in advance should email their questions to [email protected] and management will do its best to address those questions during the call. A replay of the call will be available approximately 24 hours after the call and may be accessed via the Investors page on Precipio’s website, https://www.precipiodx.com/investors/ . title: Checklist de SEO Off-Page: Nossas 8 principais dicas
summary: Use esta lista de verificação de SEO off-page para aumentar a confiabilidade, a autoridade e a visibilidade do seu site nos mecanismos de busca.
body_text: Traduzimos este artigo do inglês. Clique aqui para ler o artigo original. Se você notar algum problema com o conteúdo, não hesite em entrar em contato conosco pelo e-mail report-osteam@semrush.com . O que é SEO Off-Page? SEO off-page refere-se a ações realizadas fora do seu site para melhorar sua autoridade e confiabilidade, o que pode aprimorar a reputação da sua marca e aumentar a visibilidade tanto em buscas tradicionais quanto em buscas feitas por inteligência artificial. Algumas táticas de SEO off-page que podem ajudar a construir uma forte presença online incluem: Conseguir menções da marca em fontes confiáveis na internet. Construir backlinks de alta qualidade (links de outros sites que apontam para o seu site) Compartilhamento de conteúdo nas redes sociais E muito mais. Em contraste, o SEO on-page concentra-se em aprimorar as páginas da web por meio da criação de conteúdo de alta qualidade, incorporação de links internos, uso de estruturas de títulos adequadas, etc., para melhorar a visibilidade do seu site nos mecanismos de busca. Lista de verificação de SEO off-page 1. Analise seu perfil de backlinks E isso pode melhorar sua visibilidade nos resultados de busca. Basicamente, os backlinks sinalizam para os mecanismos de busca que seu site é confiável e merece ser classificado (aparecer nos resultados de pesquisa), desde que esses links sejam de sites relevantes e de boa reputação. É possível que um perfil de backlinks saudável também impacte sua visibilidade em ferramentas de IA. Como? Sabemos que os backlinks contribuem para um bom posicionamento no Google. Para auditar rapidamente seu perfil de backlinks, insira seu domínio na ferramenta Análise de backlinks do Semrush e acesse o relatório “ Visão geral ”. Aqui, você verá pontos de dados como: Pontuação de Autoridade : Métrica proprietária da Semrush que mede a reputação do domínio. Um número alto indica que seu domínio possui uma boa força geral em SEO. Domínios de referência : O número de domínios únicos que apontam para o seu site. Um número maior pode aumentar a autoridade do seu site, especialmente se esses sites tiverem pontuações de autoridade altas. Backlinks : O número total de links que apontam para o seu site. Em geral, um número maior é melhor. Pontuação de toxicidade geral : Uma medida de quão saudável é o seu perfil de backlinks. Uma classificação "Média" ou "Alta" indica que há espaço para melhorias. Principais âncoras : Mostra o texto âncora mais comum usado por outros domínios para criar links para você. Uma variedade natural é boa, enquanto o uso excessivo das mesmas poucas variações pode ser considerado spam. Domínios de referência por pontuação de autoridade : Revela como as pontuações de autoridade variam entre os domínios de referência. Quanto mais domínios com alta pontuação de autoridade apontarem para o seu site, melhor. Atributos de link : Mostra a divisão entre backlinks follow e nofollow . Seguir links geralmente transmite autoridade de classificação, portanto, é melhor priorizá-los. Considere esses pontos de dados e o que eles indicam. Por exemplo, um grande número de domínios de referência provenientes de sites respeitáveis com altos índices de autoridade indica que os mecanismos de busca consideram seu site uma fonte confiável. E você não precisa fazer muito para melhorar seu perfil de backlinks. 2. Analise os perfis de backlinks dos seus concorrentes. Analisar os perfis de backlinks dos seus concorrentes pode ajudá-lo a determinar se esses perfis lhes conferem alguma vantagem nos rankings. E oferecem informações valiosas sobre suas táticas de construção de links. Por exemplo, se seus concorrentes conseguiram muitos backlinks de alta qualidade usando infográficos, você poderia começar a criar seus próprios infográficos. Idealmente, versões ainda melhores do que as que seus concorrentes estão publicando. Use a ferramenta Backlink Gap do Semrush para analisar os perfis de links dos seus concorrentes juntamente com os seus. Basta inserir seu domínio e os domínios de até quatro concorrentes. Em seguida, clique em “ Encontrar potenciais clientes .” Desça a página até a seção “Oportunidades para”. Certifique-se de que seu domínio esteja selecionado e clique na guia “ Melhores ” para gerar uma lista de domínios que têm links para sites de concorrentes, mas não para o seu. Clique nas setas nas colunas dos concorrentes para ver quais páginas atraem backlinks de um domínio específico. Assim: Analise essas informações para identificar domínios de alto valor e os tipos de conteúdo para os quais eles tendem a gerar links. E use isso para orientar seus esforços de construção de links. 3. Crie backlinks de alta qualidade Além de buscar oportunidades nos backlinks de seus concorrentes, considere diversas outras táticas de construção de links ao analisar sua lista de verificação de SEO off-page. Cada uma dessas táticas pode melhorar a visibilidade nas buscas tradicionais e, possivelmente, a visibilidade da sua busca com IA. Você pode [construir backlinks] fazendo networking com blogueiros do setor (eles podem citar seu conteúdo em suas próprias postagens), buscando oportunidades de publicação como convidado (você geralmente pode incluir um backlink no artigo ou na biografia do autor) ou entrevistando influenciadores (eles costumam citar e compartilhar a entrevista em suas próprias plataformas). Aqui estão algumas ideias adicionais para criar backlinks de alta qualidade: Recuperar links quebrados . Encontre links externos quebrados nos sites de destino e ofereça uma página alternativa com conteúdo relevante do seu site. Encontrar menções de marcas não relacionadas. Localize menções à sua marca que não incluam um link e solicite um. Criar recursos vinculáveis. Crie conteúdo original e exclusivo, como relatórios de pesquisa, infográficos, ferramentas ou guias que atraiam backlinks naturalmente. Fornecer aconselhamento especializado. Compartilhe sua experiência por meio de entrevistas, podcasts ou respondendo a solicitações da mídia. As editoras geralmente fornecem um link quando citam você. Mas mesmo que não o façam, você pode obter uma menção da marca, o que pode impactar a visibilidade da sua IA. Priorize as técnicas que parecem mais adequadas para o seu negócio. Por exemplo, se a sua empresa emprega especialistas líderes do setor, compartilhar o conhecimento deles com redatores e jornalistas é uma abordagem sensata para adquirir backlinks. Acesse a ferramenta, insira seu domínio e clique em “ Iniciar Link Building ” para configurar sua campanha . Uma vez na ferramenta, vá para a guia “ Prospectos ”. Aqui você encontrará uma lista de sites promissores para contato. Você pode querer priorizar sites com altas pontuações de autoridade (listadas na coluna “AS”). Porque esses sites de boa reputação podem ajudá-lo a construir melhor sua própria autoridade. Depois de selecionar alguns sites e saber qual tática de link building você deseja usar, marque as caixas ao lado desses sites, selecione o menu suspenso ao lado do campo "Em Andamento" e escolha a tática que você usará. Vá para a aba “ Em Andamento ”—os seus clientes potenciais escolhidos agora aparecem aqui. Clique em “ Contato ” para enviar um e-mail a um potencial cliente diretamente da Ferramenta de Construção de Links. Os endereços de e-mail de contato disponíveis serão adicionados automaticamente. Assim que você conseguir um backlink de um potencial cliente, mova esse site para a aba “Monitorar” clicando na marca de seleção na coluna da extrema direita. Assim, você pode monitorar se perdeu o backlink ou se um domínio de referência deixou de estar ativo. 4. Ganhe menções à sua marca Conseguir menções à marca significa ter o nome da sua empresa referenciado na internet, o que pode impactar positivamente o seu SEO e a sua visibilidade em ferramentas de IA. Ser referenciado por outras pessoas pode colocar você em contato com novos públicos que têm maior probabilidade de clicar nos seus resultados nos mecanismos de busca. E agora sabemos que o algoritmo Navboost do Google considera o comportamento relacionado a cliques para influenciar as classificações. E como ser mencionado com mais frequência pode levar a mais buscas pela marca, obter menções à marca aumenta suas chances de aparecer nas respostas de ferramentas de IA. Aqui estão algumas táticas para conseguir mais menções à sua marca: Conteúdo gerado pelo usuário (UGC) campanhas : Incentive seus clientes a compartilhar suas experiências com seus produtos/serviços em plataformas de mídia social. Você pode até oferecer incentivos, como sorteios ou destaques em seus canais oficiais, para motivá-los. Comunicados de imprensa : Sempre que tiver algo relevante para compartilhar (como o lançamento de um novo produto ou um marco importante da empresa), redija um comunicado de imprensa e distribua-o para os veículos de comunicação. Participações em podcasts e webinars : Apresente o seu próprio podcast ou participe como convidado em podcasts ou webinars populares do setor. Marketing de afiliados : Inicie um programa de afiliados que permita que outras pessoas promovam sua marca em troca de uma comissão. Você precisará de um orçamento específico para comissões, então planeje-se adequadamente. Educação gratuita : Ofereça workshops, seminários ou cursos gratuitos relacionados ao seu setor. Para posicionar sua marca como uma autoridade. Você também precisará de uma forma de monitorar se esses esforços estão aumentando as menções à sua marca. E se essas menções tiverem um sentimento positivo. É aqui que o aplicativo Monitoramento de Mídia pode ajudar. Você pode filtrar os resultados por categoria, sentimento ou importância para se concentrar no que é mais relevante. 5. Participe ativamente dos fóruns Ao participar de fóruns e comunidades online relevantes, você pode aumentar sua visibilidade tanto nos resultados de busca tradicionais quanto nos de inteligência artificial. Especialmente para consultas comerciais como "melhor ferramenta de produtividade para equipes". Essas conversas em fóruns também aparecem em ferramentas de IA como ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews e AI Mode. Nosso Estudo de Modo de IA mostra que o Reddit é o domínio mais citado entre essas plataformas de IA. Se os usuários clicarem nesses links para acessar as discussões, poderão ver informações sobre você ou até mesmo suas próprias ideias, e ficarão mais propensos a procurar seu conteúdo posteriormente. Para tirar o máximo proveito da participação em fóruns, evite ser excessivamente promocional ou compartilhar links para seu site, a menos que seja realmente útil. Por exemplo, a imagem abaixo mostra um usuário compartilhando recursos úteis para iniciantes em SEO em um tópico do Reddit: “Você precisa ser humano.” O Reddit não é um lugar para marcas e formalidades — ele não foi criado para isso. Defina um número fixo de palavras-chave e subreddits relevantes para sua marca e verifique-os diariamente em busca de oportunidades para contribuir positivamente para a discussão. Ao responder a partir de uma conta de marca, personalize sua resposta assinando com seu nome, lembrando aos usuários que há uma pessoa por trás do perfil. Portanto, participe das discussões do Reddit com respostas genuínas, experiências reais e um toque pessoal. Leitura adicional : Marketing no Reddit para Iniciantes: Como fazer marketing com sucesso no Reddit 6. Otimize para SEO local Isso ajuda você a aparecer no Google Maps e nos resultados de pesquisa para palavras-chave com intenção de busca local. Como em “restaurantes indianos em Nova York”: Para aparecer nas buscas locais, siga estas dicas: Crie e otimize seu Perfil do Google Meu Negócio (GBP). Um perfil otimizado pode fazer com que sua empresa apareça com mais destaque nas buscas locais e garantir que os usuários tenham informações atualizadas sobre o seu negócio. Obtenha listagens de diretórios locais com informações consistentes. Os diretórios locais (Yelp, TripAdvisor, etc.) oferecem outra maneira para os clientes descobrirem sua empresa. Garantir que seus anúncios tenham informações consistentes pode melhorar a visibilidade nos resultados de busca tradicionais e aumentar a probabilidade de que as ferramentas de IA forneçam informações precisas sobre sua empresa. Incentive avaliações. Acumular avaliações (especialmente as positivas) pode aumentar a confiança dos usuários e até mesmo proporcionar maior visibilidade nas buscas tradicionais e de IA. Além disso, crie o hábito de responder às avaliações dos clientes para demonstrar que você valoriza o feedback e proteger sua reputação. Você pode responder às avaliações do Google usando sua conta do Google Meu Negócio. E receba notificações sobre avaliações em outros diretórios. Acesse a ferramenta, encontre sua empresa e cadastre-se para obter uma conta. Assim que acessar o painel principal, você verá uma visão geral das suas avaliações. Incluindo sua avaliação média. Deslize a tela para baixo para configurar respostas automáticas, se desejar. A ferramenta fornecerá inclusive uma estimativa da sua economia de tempo. Deslize a página para baixo para ver as avaliações. Onde você pode criar respostas manualmente ou clicar em “ Gerar rascunho ” para obter ajuda da IA. Clique em “ Responder ” quando estiver pronto para postar sua resposta. Leitura complementar : Um guia para iniciantes em gestão de reputação online 7. Compartilhe conteúdo nas redes sociais Promover seu conteúdo nas redes sociais pode gerar mais tráfego para seu site, aumentar as chances de mais pessoas descobrirem e criarem links para seu conteúdo e até mesmo levar a mais buscas pela sua marca posteriormente. Além disso, páginas, publicações e vídeos de redes sociais podem aparecer nos resultados de pesquisa. Os vídeos também tendem a influenciar as respostas da IA. Por exemplo, esta resposta do ChatGPT faz referência a um tutorial do YouTube: Aqui estão algumas práticas recomendadas para compartilhar conteúdo nas redes sociais: Escolha as plataformas certas. Por exemplo, o Instagram e o Pinterest funcionam bem para empresas de decoração de interiores. Reaproveite seu conteúdo. Utilize o mesmo conteúdo de maneiras diferentes para adaptá-lo à plataforma e ampliar seu alcance. Por exemplo, divida um webinar em vídeos curtos do YouTube ou transforme uma postagem de blog em posts para o Instagram. Incentive sua equipe. Capacite sua equipe para compartilhar seu conteúdo em suas contas pessoais de redes sociais. Para ampliar seu alcance e apresentá-la a novos públicos. Interaja com seu público. Responda aos comentários, faça perguntas e incentive outras interações. Usuários que veem uma marca interagindo ativamente têm maior probabilidade de interagir e compartilhar o conteúdo também. Não exagere na promoção de conteúdo. Muitos usuários observaram que as plataformas de mídia social parecem suprimir publicações que compartilham links. Portanto, seja seletivo quanto aos links que você compartilha e quando os compartilha. Esta ferramenta permite agendar e publicar posts em diferentes plataformas. E você pode usar IA para redigir seu conteúdo. O Social Poster também possui um calendário interativo que você pode usar para planejar meses de conteúdo para redes sociais com antecedência. 8. Colabore com influenciadores Estabelecer parcerias com criadores de conteúdo online do seu nicho que possuam um público amplo e engajado pode apresentar seu produto ou serviço a novos públicos. E isso pode levar a mais buscas pela marca, menções à marca e backlinks no futuro. Basta garantir que encontre influenciadores cujo público esteja alinhado com o seu mercado-alvo e cujo conteúdo reflita os valores e objetivos da sua marca. Você pode pesquisar influenciadores manualmente em diversas plataformas. Para uma abordagem mais rápida na identificação de influenciadores, experimente o aplicativo Influencer Analytics . Comece selecionando a plataforma na qual deseja se concentrar no menu suspenso "Descobrir influenciadores". Em seguida, digite na barra de pesquisa o tipo de influenciadores que você está procurando. E escolha um método de pesquisa — recomendamos “ Descrição do canal .” Utilize os filtros (para especificar orçamento, número de assinantes, etc.) se desejar refinar ainda mais os resultados. Clique no perfil de um influenciador individual para obter informações adicionais e detalhes sobre como contatá-lo. E clique em “ Nas listas ” para adicioná-los a uma lista existente ou criar uma nova lista de influenciadores que você deseja contatar. Depois de identificar potenciais influenciadores, certifique-se de que eles se encaixam bem, analisando sua presença nas redes sociais. Especificamente, você pode: Analise o conteúdo de melhor desempenho. Verifique que tipo de conteúdo gera mais repercussão entre o público deles. Leia os comentários da audiência. Veja o que os seguidores deles dizem e o que eles parecem achar mais interessante. Verifique se são compatíveis com a marca. Certifique-se de que o estilo e o tom do influenciador estejam alinhados com a sua marca. Acompanhe o sucesso do seu SEO off-page Utilizar uma lista de atividades de SEO off-page para implementar mudanças pode levar a melhores resultados. Em seguida, você pode monitorar várias métricas para garantir que seus esforços estejam trazendo resultados: Backlinks : Observe o número total de backlinks que você recebe e quantos domínios de referência você possui. Menções à marca : Monitore o volume de menções à marca ao longo do tempo e onde essas menções ocorrem. Engajamento social : Fique de olho em curtidas, compartilhamentos, comentários e menções para ver se os usuários estão interagindo com seu conteúdo. Para ver o impacto que o seu trabalho fora da página tem no seu desempenho nas ferramentas de IA, use o AI Visibility Toolkit da Semrush. Isso permite monitorar sua participação em relação aos concorrentes, ver como você é mencionado em respostas específicas de IA e até mesmo receber sugestões de estratégia. She began her career in print and digital editorial leadership roles before transitioning to SEO and digital marketing, focusing on data-driven strategies. She‘s passionate about ensuring operational efficiency, upholding editorial standards, and mentoring writers to deliver top-quality, brand-aligned content.

title: Lightspeed Commerce Celebrates 20 Years in Business Through Newly Released Q4 Product Innovations
summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc., the one-stop commerce platform empowering merchants to provide the best omnichannel experiences, today highlighted some of its new product advancements in retail, hospitality and golf. “Lightspeed just […]
body_text: Find news All Product Company Data and Insights Company Lightspeed Commerce Celebrates 20 Years in Business Through Newly Released Q4 Product Innovations 2025-05-08 minute read Share Lightspeed Commerce Inc. , the one-stop commerce platform empowering merchants to provide the best omnichannel experiences, today highlighted some of its new product advancements in retail, hospitality and golf. “Lightspeed just entered its 20th year in business, and we wouldn’t be where we are today without a dedicated commitment to providing product innovation that supports our customers’ growth ambitions,” said Dax Dasilva, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Lightspeed. “Retailers and restaurants around the globe are facing complex challenges to their business, and it’s our goal to help those customers better understand their operations, their customers and their opportunities for growth.” Lightspeed’s Q4 innovations brought a number of new products and feature sets across the retail and hospitality industries, including: Retail Forecast demand with greater accuracy using seasonal trends Lightspeed’s Retail Insights now analyzes sales patterns and seasonal trends to forecast demand with precision and ensure optimal inventory levels, reducing overstock and out-of-stock periods, maximizing sales. Available on plans that include Lightspeed Insights. Understand your data in an instant with sales visualisations You shouldn’t need a BI degree to understand your data, Lightspeed Insights has made this even easier for merchants with the addition of sales visualisations, turn your data into easy to interpret visual graphs to understand in a snapshot how your business is performing without sifting through spreadsheets. Lightspeed’s new Generative AI web builder takes the frustration out of web design Lightspeed’s cutting-edge new AI-driven website building tool, is designed to help retail merchants generate website elements from a simple screen grab. No need for manual coding or third party developers. This innovative tool lets retailers create custom web elements without coding by using AI to analyze screen captures and generate production-ready code. Merchants simply describe or show Lightspeed’s Website Builder what they want using real-world examples, and the tool builds them fully integrated, professional-looking online stores with speed and ease. Lightspeed NuORDER advancements streamline inventory operations Lightspeed’s NuORDER Wholesale Network now includes PO Sync, a two way sync to drive fast, automated replenishments for retailers. Now retailers can place a replenishment directly in POS and have this sent to their supplier on Lightspeed NuORDER without leaving the platform. Retailers can also now connect multiple NuORDER buyer accounts, ensuring that all orders—regardless of who placed them—seamlessly sync to the POS. Now, when retailers import a NuORDER PO, the supplier name will automatically populate—saving time and reducing manual errors. Lightspeed NuORDER expands partnership offering for brands Brands now have two new ways to join Lightspeed NuORDER to work with Lightspeed’s POS retailers. This offering makes it easy for brands to join Lightspeed’s network and accept orders or share catalogs with POS retailers, helping them increase average order value, drive faster, streamlined reordering and maintain accuracy with product information. These offerings via NuORDER – Catalog and Connect are expansions to the existing NuORDER offering for brands wanting to collaborate with retailers using Lightspeed. Drive more gift card sales with Omni gift cards and promotions Retailer’s gift cards can now be redeemed in-store and online, a huge unlock for omnichannel retailers who can now manage one gift card platform for both channels. Hospitality Drive traffic and online orders with Order with Google integration Lightspeed Restaurants merchants using Order Anywhere can now increase their exposure and drive more traffic to their online ordering stores with Order with Google integration. This integration helps merchants gain more exposure, increase orders, and offer a convenient ordering experience, all leading to higher revenue and more business opportunities. Effortlessly divide checks by seat or cover on Tableside Lightspeed’s mobile POS, Tableside , just became more pow erful. Merchants can now divide checks by seat or cover on a variety of devices powered by Lightspeed Tableside. This new functionality provides greater flexibility, ensures a smoother payment experience, and saves time for the customer. Lightspeed KDS enhancements make chefs happier Two new KDS features launched, designed to make communication between front-of-house and back-of-house even better: Improve order accuracy with advanced production instructions. Merchants can now add custom production instructions to items, and this info flows seamlessly from the POS to KDS to minimize errors, and facilitate guest safety with clear, automatic allergen highlights on kitchen tickets so merchants never miss an allergen. Boost kitchen efficiency with consolidated items list. KDS now offers the capability to group identical items from all tickets into a consolidated list, allowing chefs to prepare items in batches, significantly reducing prep time and boosting kitchen efficiency. To learn more about these new features, visit Lightspeed’s website . title: Wabash and Echo Global Logistics Partner to Expand Drop Trailer Business
summary: Wabash (NYSE: WNC), a premier provider of diverse solutions that optimize customers’ end-to-end supply chains across transportation, logistics and infrastructure markets, today announced a new partnership with Echo Global Logistics, Inc. (“Echo”), a leading provider of technology-enabled transportation and supply chain management services ...
body_text: Lafayette, IN, 01 May 2025 | 08:52 AM America/New_York Wabash and Echo Global Logistics Partner to Expand Drop Trailer Business Wabash’s Trailers as a Service (TaaS)℠ Helps Echo Unlock New Revenue Opportunities and Better Serve Customers Wabash (NYSE: WNC) , a premier provider of diverse solutions that optimize customers’ end-to-end supply chains across transportation, logistics and infrastructure markets, today announced a new partnership with Echo Global Logistics, Inc. (“Echo”) , a leading provider of technology-enabled transportation and supply chain management services and voted the #1 third-party logistics provider (3PL) by Inbound Logistics' Top 10 3PL Excellence Awards for eight consecutive years. Echo has selected Wabash’s Trailers as a Service (TaaS)℠ to grow its drop trailer program and enhance service offerings for shippers and carriers nationwide. The partnership enables Echo to leverage Wabash’s expertise in trailer solutions to address a growing demand for flexible freight options. By integrating TaaS into its operations, Echo gains access to capacity on demand without the complexity of fleet ownership. This comprehensive solution allows Echo to expand its customized services in drop trailer freight and deliver greater value to its clients. “Drop trailers are at the heart of creating efficiencies for shippers and carriers, and Wabash’s TaaS solution aligns with our mission to simplify transportation management,” said Jay Gustafson, Executive Vice President of Brokerage Operations at Echo. “This partnership combines Echo’s freight expertise with Wabash’s unmatched trailer solutions. Together, we’re providing a seamless, scalable solution that helps us meet our clients’ evolving needs while driving innovation and growth for our business.” Wabash’s TaaS offers a scalable solution that bundles trailer capacity with maintenance, repair, and telematics, delivered through Wabash’s extensive national dealer and preferred partner network. This all-in, managed-care model eliminates operational inefficiencies of fleet management and allows Echo to focus on delivering reliable, tech-enabled freight solutions. “We’re proud to partner with Echo, one of the most tech-forward 3PLs in the industry, to support their growth in the drop trailer space,” said Mike Pettit, Chief Growth Officer at Wabash. “Echo’s decision to integrate TaaS into their operations highlights the strength of our platform and our ability to adapt to the unique needs of leading freight brokers. Together, we’re driving meaningful efficiencies and opening new opportunities for Echo and its shippers and carriers.” This partnership marks a significant milestone for Echo, as it builds out its drop trailer program to align with its position as an industry leader. With Wabash’s TaaS platform, Echo can confidently pursue new opportunities and further differentiate its offerings in a competitive market. Learn more about TaaS at marketplace.onewabash.com/trailers-as-a-service . Wabash: Changing How the World Reaches You Wabash (NYSE: WNC) combines physical and digital technologies to deliver innovative, end-to-end solutions that optimize supply chains across transportation, logistics and infrastructure markets. Headquartered in Lafayette, Indiana, Wabash designs, manufactures, and services an extensive range of products supporting first-to-final mile operations, including dry and refrigerated trailers and truck bodies, platform trailers, tank trailers, structural composites and more. In addition, through the Wabash Marketplace and Wabash Parts, customers gain access to a nationwide parts and service network, Trailers as a Service (TaaS)℠, and advanced tools designed to streamline operations and drive growth. By enabling businesses to thrive today and prepare for tomorrow, Wabash is Changing How the World Reaches You®. Learn more at onewabash.com . About Echo Global Logistics Echo Global Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of technology-enabled transportation and supply chain management services. Headquartered in Chicago with more than 30 offices across North America, Echo offers freight brokerage and Managed Transportation Solutions for all major modes, including Truckload, Partial Truckload, LTL, Intermodal, Cross-Border, Temperature-Controlled shipping and warehousing, and Warehouse Services. Named one of Newsweek\\\'s Most Trusted Companies in America, Echo leverages its advanced, web-based and mobile app technology, analyzing data from its network of more than 50,000 transportation providers to help its 35,000 clients simplify the critical tasks involved in transportation management. For more information on Echo Global Logistics, visit: www.echo.com.
